verificationMethod: Pricing is verified daily against vendor sources. Small drift (under 25% on input and output) is auto-applied; larger changes are reviewed by a human editor before publication. Vendor pricing pages are the canonical source of truth.

models.name: Claude Fable 5
models.notes: Anthropic's newest premium-tier model. Priced 2x above Opus 4.8 — positioned for the hardest reasoning workloads where the cost is worth the quality bump.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Anthropic's current flagship — succeeded Opus 4.7. Same pricing as the prior generation. Best-in-class reasoning for the hardest agentic decisions.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8 Fast
models.notes: Low-latency variant of Opus 4.8 — 2x the price for guaranteed throughput and faster time-to-first-token. Right pick for production agentic loops where latency matters.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.7
models.notes: Previous flagship — superseded by Opus 4.8 (2026-05-28) at the same price. Still accessible via API for backwards compatibility.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: The sweet spot. Handles ~90% of agent workflows at a fraction of Opus pricing.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fast and cheap. Best for high-volume classification and short replies.

models.name: GPT-5.5
models.notes: OpenAI's frontier line. Marketed for coding and professional work.

models.name: GPT-5.4
models.notes: The full GPT-5.4 — not the mini. Comparable pricing to Claude Sonnet with OpenAI's tool-use and computer-use stack.

models.name: GPT-5.3 Codex
models.notes: OpenAI's coding-specific model — powers the Codex CLI and ChatGPT cloud-runner agent. Tuned for software engineering tasks; competitive with Claude Sonnet on coding-only benchmarks at lower input cost.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Largest context window on the list. Pricing shown is for prompts ≤200k tokens; rises to $2.50/$15 above that.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Hybrid reasoning model with 1M context and tunable thinking budgets.

models.name: Gemini 3 Flash Preview
models.notes: Google's high-speed thinking model for agentic workflows. Strong on coding and multi-turn chat. Top 5 on public model marketplaces this week.

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview
models.notes: Google's most cost-efficient model. Optimised for high-volume agentic tasks and simple data processing.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Together AI)
models.notes: Open weights. The price shown reflects Together AI; other inference providers host the same weights at different rates.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
models.notes: DeepSeek's value tier. Cache-hit pricing drops input to $0.0028/M on repeat queries.

models.name: DeepSeek V3.2
models.notes: DeepSeek's capable open-weight model. Extraordinary value — frontier-class performance at $0.25/M input. Top 3 on public model marketplaces this week.

models.name: GLM 5.2
models.notes: z.ai's current flagship — successor to GLM 5.1. ~50% price bump from 5.1 traded for 5x context (1M tokens) and stronger reasoning/tool-use benchmarks.

models.name: GLM 5.1
models.notes: Previous z.ai flagship — superseded by GLM 5.2 (2026-06-13). Still available; cheaper than 5.2 if 200k context is enough.

models.name: Mistral Large 2.1
models.notes: European frontier model. Stronger data residency story than US providers — useful for EU compliance-heavy workflows.
